verdict.rationale:
Docs explicitly describe skills as harness-agnostic with per-harness install instructions for Claude Code, Codex, Devin CLI, Hermes Agent, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity, plus a formal porting guide for new harnesses. This is corroborated by a runtime probe showing a real cross-agent install (skills add ... -a claude-code) and community commentary confirming multi-harness installs exist (though one commenter finds the codex/opencode install mechanism unpolished).
missing for 10: independent hands-on verification across all named harnesses (Cursor specifically isn't confirmed working), and community feedback on install reliability skews mixed.
